title: Set and record numeric low-resource budgets
description: Convert the PRD’s relative low-resource requirements into release budgets after baseline measurement, with owner-approved scope and explicit limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: Budgets cover readiness, idle/peak RSS, CPU, control-plane latency, reconnect time, and regression threshold
Each budget identifies the host/workload/evidence level and whether it is a hard gate or advisory
Budgets do not claim absolute tunnel throughput unless a real representative tunnel benchmark exists
The release gate reports pass/fail/unknown and blocks unknown required gates

steps.details: Read TASK-57/58/59 outputs and identify the selected VPS, RAM, swap, vCPU, artifact, and workload.
Set conservative numeric budgets from observed baseline and desired no-regression rule; include measurement confidence and limitations.
Write `.agent/evidence/task-60-resource-budgets.md` with budgets, owner, date, rationale, and any approved waiver. Do not silently invent approval.
Make the benchmark command compare candidate results to the recorded budgets and return nonzero for a hard-gate failure.

technicalNotes: The 10% regression rule is a product decision already recorded; absolute numbers require measurement and owner acceptance.
